### The Ark Returns to Israel
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/ark-returns-to-israel
Passage: 1 Samuel 6:20
Points:
- The Philistines realized Yahweh was not a mere rival god and returned the ark with a guilt offering.
- God overruled natural instincts by guiding unyoked milk cows straight back toward Israel.
- Irreverence carried severe consequences when the men of Beth-shemesh inappropriately looked into the ark.
- God cannot be handled like a superstitious talisman or manipulated by human rituals.
- Believers must approach the Lord with holy fear rather than treating Him casually.

### Day 9: 1 Samuel 6:1–12
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-9-1-samuel-6-112.html
Passage: 1 Samuel 6:8
Points:
- The Philistine leaders attempted to rig the test by using unyoked cows separated from their calves.
- People often fall into the trap of trying to manipulate circumstances to get their desired answer from God.
- Forcing outcomes rather than trusting God leads to spiritual foolishness and pain.
- Creation readily submits to its Maker, as the cows overcame natural impulses to follow God's direction.
- The Lord sovereignly accomplishes His purposes even through unlikely instruments.
